name: Security / Safe Autonomous Execution
one_liner: Make secret leakage, prompt-injected tool calls, unsafe egress and unauthorized side effects deterministic build failures.
core_thesis: Autonomous coding and commerce fail catastrophically if safety depends on an LLM remembering rules. Security must be expressed as machine-enforced preconditions and postconditions: secret patterns, capability scopes, egress allowlists, irreversible-action grants, untrusted-repo preflight and tamper-evident receipts.
why_now: Every other project increasingly lets agents interact with real accounts, repositories and money.
user: All autonomous agents and projects in the portfolio
job: Prevent a capable but untrusted agent from converting mistakes or injections into irreversible damage.
distribution: Mandatory shared gate in every campaign.
moat: Cross-project failure corpus and deterministic policies tuned from real incidents.
falsifiers: Policies block so much useful work that autonomy collapses.
Coverage remains too incomplete to materially reduce risk.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
software_substitution_test.rationale: Static security software commoditizes; deployed adversarial telemetry and trusted incident history compound as agents become more capable.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Protect one real consequential action and learn from one attack/failure path
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Put a deterministic capability/secret/egress gate in front of one live autonomous campaign action, run a small adversarial battery, and store the blocked/allowed result with adjudication.

steps.action: Choose one consequential action and explicit allow policy
Human or trusted oracle labels consequential failures

underengineer.graduation_rule: Real campaign incidents automatically become regression worlds and measurably prevent recurrence.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If the gate cannot sit on the consequence boundary, do not pretend upstream text classification is a security moat.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.
